description: Meteor Client add-on for Minecraft (Fabric, Java 21) that visualises predicted ore veins using orefinder.gg's WASM model, validated against the loaded world, plus optional server-specific utility modules. Hobby project for learning Fabric modding and running WASM in-process on the JVM.

mods.name: Orekas
mods.description: Ore-vein ESP for Meteor Client, powered by orefinder.gg's WASM model with live-world validation and an anti-xray fallback heuristic.
